prevention.title: Sleep as everyday prevention
prevention.summary: Consistent sleep supports immunity, mood, and metabolic health.

A darker cooler room and less caffeine after mid-afternoon help. Limit bright screens in the last hour before bed.

Loud snoring, gasping, or heavy daytime sleepiness deserve a clinic mention. Sleep problems pair often with high blood pressure and weight concerns.
